scope: Offline V10 diagnostic only; no capacity or acceptance inference. Original report verdict retained verbatim for allowed fields. Inputs streamed once after operator-confirmed completion.

retention.anonymousStderr: Every valid strict-schema delivery/slow-span row is streamed to disk without a row/byte retention cap; non-whitelisted stderr is discarded. Memory candidate/top lists are capped separately. Oversize lines over 1 MiB are counted and omitted.

observer.rule: Global candidates require another observer peer/projection evidence; personal self/wire-local 1000 is excluded.

owner.rule: Global candidates require another observer peer/projection evidence; personal self/wire-local 1000 is excluded.

anonymousStderr.retention: All accepted strict-schema rows; no raw stderr content; exact oversized u64/u128 values are decimal strings.

limits: Global Zone mapping uses another observer peer/projection evidence only; personal self/wire-local ID 1000 never becomes a global candidate. Candidate mappings are not resolved by guessing.

UserLocation target is the recipient global Zone ID. No client trace ID exists: unique-record-match is exactly one complete candidate in a 30-second producer window, not cryptographic packet identity. Repeated packets remain candidates.

Registration is linked to fatal observer/owner only by accepted delivery recipientZoneID evidence. Multiple registrations or global candidates remain explicit; batchID/batchIndex remain visible without invented packet linkage.

read_gate and completion_to_pop may be emitted later when a packet is dropped. recordedUnixMs is emission time: recordedUnixMs minus elapsedUs MUST NOT be treated as an actual gate/gap window. Fatal-window lists for these stages use emission time only.

health_schedule, health_run, health_await and send are logged after measurement. Estimated intervals expose 1 ms timestamp quantization under a stable wall clock; extra scheduling/clock error is not bounded. These estimates do not prove exact wall-clock overlap.

completion_to_pop includes ordinary empty-queue waiting and does not establish queue backlog or network causality. health_await includes schedule, run and resume work; stage durations overlap and MUST NOT be added.
normalDepth/ownerDepth are logged snapshots, not time-integrated backlog. A long span, matching registration or matching batch is diagnostic association, not a causal attribution.

serverTraceID groups sort by Instant elapsedUs, never stderr line order. sent means send/flush return, not client receive. Receive-after-estimated-sent combines network/client/clock uncertainty and cannot isolate network delay.

Owner boundary detection needs retained observer transform on the same map. First coverage ghost/missing/loss does not expose the pair grace timer start. Final remove is final within fatal +/-15 seconds only.
Original report false verdicts stay false; diagnostics cannot certify capacity or frontend acceptance. Samples/private stderr each have one complete physical read with exact source-byte SHA256.

Only strict anonymous numeric/enumerated delivery and slow-span rows are saved from stderr. Other private stderr is never retained or printed. Finite memory caps and oversized-line omissions can make summaries incomplete; the anonymous archive avoids a second private-stderr scan.
